name: Low TV Stand
description: Low media console, 1400 x 400 x 450 mm: open-front 18 mm shell split by a center divider, with two 60 mm cable holes through the back.

steps.instruction: Create the TV-stand blank: a box 1400 mm wide (X), 400 mm deep (Y) and 450 mm tall, centered in X and Y with its base on Z=0. The front face is at Y=-200.

transcript.user_prompt: Let's model a low TV stand: a solid blank 1400 mm wide (X), 400 mm deep (Y) and 450 mm tall (Z), centered in X and Y with its base on the floor at Z=0 and its front face at Y=-200.
transcript.assistant_message: I've blocked out the 1400 x 400 x 450 mm media-console blank with the front at Y=-200.

steps.instruction: Shell the blank with 18 mm walls, leaving the front face (Y=-200) fully open.

transcript.user_prompt: Hollow it out: shell the blank with 18 mm walls on the back, sides, top and bottom, leaving the whole front face at Y=-200 open for media gear.
transcript.assistant_message: The console is hollowed into an open-front shell with 18 mm walls - a 1364 mm wide, 414 mm tall bay behind the opening.

steps.instruction: Add a vertical center divider 18 mm thick, centered at X=0, spanning Y=-200 (the front opening) to Y=182 (the inside of the back wall) and Z=18 (the inside of the bottom) to Z=432 (the inside of the top), fused into the shell.

transcript.user_prompt: Split the bay in two: add a vertical divider 18 mm thick centered at X=0. It should span the interior exactly: from the front opening at Y=-200 back to the inside face of the back wall at Y=182, and from the inside of the bottom at Z=18 up to the inside of the top at Z=432. Fuse it into the shell.
transcript.assistant_message: The center divider is in, splitting the console into two 673 mm wide equipment bays.

steps.instruction: Cut two 60 mm diameter cable holes horizontally (along Y) through the back wall, centered at X=+/-350, Z=350. The back wall spans Y=182 to Y=200, so each hole must pass through that full 18 mm thickness.

transcript.user_prompt: Add cable management: cut two 60 mm diameter holes straight through the back wall along Y, one per bay, centered at X=+/-350 and Z=350. The back wall spans Y=182 to Y=200 - make sure the holes pierce its full 18 mm thickness.
transcript.assistant_message: Both 60 mm cable holes are through the back wall at X=+/-350 - one feed per bay, up at 350 mm behind the gear.
